agent_explanation: High-speed (~53 m/s) body strikes thin (0.2 thick) wall. Per-step displacement ~0.6 exceeds wall thickness plus correction budget, so discrete impulse plus positional correction at dt=0.01216 fails to eject the circle; by step 2 it sits 0.228 deep in overlap. Reducing dt alone removes the failure, pointing to inadequate continuous collision / substep resolution for fast vs thin-wall impacts.
